result.summary: Found 3 visual issues on this food delivery app screen: one major layout/content truncation issue and two minor cosmetic concerns.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel shows 'Trattoria Piccol' — the name is abruptly cut off mid-word without an ellipsis. While partial card visibility is an intentional carousel pattern, the text should be truncated with '...' rather than just clipped at the card boundary.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis and overflow: hidden to the restaurant name label so it gracefully truncates instead of cutting off mid-word.

issues.description: The last visible category filter pill (after 'Healthy') is partially cut off at the right edge with no visual indicator (e.g., fade gradient) that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-side gradient fade over the filter pills row to communicate scrollability and improve discoverability of additional categories.

issues.description: The third restaurant card image in 'Fastest near you' appears noticeably darker/blurred compared to the first two cards, creating a visual inconsistency in the row.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all restaurant thumbnail images in the carousel use consistent brightness and image quality standards, or apply a uniform overlay treatment across all cards.
